swecris.name: Swecris (Swedish research funding)
swecris.note: mixed governmental and private funders; funder_type per record; government-only split in aggregates.json

limitations: Sampled, not census: NIH RePORTER records were stratified-sampled to 2000 (1531 with abstracts); CORDIS 558 of 616 in-window projects.
Amounts are recorded per award/project record; multi-year values are not annualised.
amount_eur uses fixed ECB reference rates; cross-currency totals are indicative only.
Category labels are model/rules output, not human-verified; a 30-record human benchmark is produced separately.
CORDIS country is the first listed organisation country, not the official coordinator.
